table: Table S1, DOPC columns, printed page 13 (PDF page 14), Figure 2A
preparation: Protein-free large unilamellar DOPC/cholesterol vesicles with 0.1 mol% NBD-PE tracer, equilibrated with methyl-beta-cyclodextrin at room temperature.
activity_reference: Unit activity is crystalline cholesterol at room temperature.
uncertainty: The two error columns are the reported 68% confidence half-widths of extracted values. Both coordinates share a fit, and activity uses a common calibration. Their covariances are unavailable. The activity half-width printed as 0.00 is rounded.
